title: The brain's share of the oxygen

probes.question: What share of the body weight does the human brain represent?
The brain receives 25% of which of these?

image.alt: A teal brain made of two joined lobes with lighter fold lines and an orange lightning bolt outlined in cream across its centre.

body.question: The human brain represents only 2% of the body weight. What percentage of total body oxygen consumption does it receive?
body.reveal: It receives 20% of total body oxygen consumption, along with 15% of the cardiac output and 25% of total body glucose utilization.
